title: Finding character in a string

lines.explanation: Defining a function 'index_string' and passing the arguments 'test_string' which is the input string and 'symbol_string' which is the character to be found in the 'test_string'
For loop iterates through each element(character) of the string
It checks the condition whether the current character matches the symbol_string
If yes, then it returns the index of that element in the string.
If the element is not found, then it returns -1.
